d:
Patna Municipal Corporation : patna ki saphaee vyavastha ko durust karne ke lie nagar nigam ne taiyari tej kar di hai. mahapaur sita sahu ki adhyakshata men huee baithak men rajdhani ki saphaee vyavastha ko behtar banane par charcha huee. tyoharon ke dauran atirikt saphaee karmiyon ki tainati aur dor-tu-dor kachra uthav ke lie ejensi ke chayan par bhi manthan kiya gaya.
Aakhir patna ki saphaee vyavastha ko lekar kya hai nagar nigam ki yojna? tyoharon par shahar ko saph rakhne ke lie kya kadam uthae jaenge? dekhie puri riporta.
